direction: Run one stability-focused follow-up to the seeded direct XGBoost Tweedie champion. Make the recipe shallower and more regularized, with a lower learning rate and early stopping, to test whether the apparent Gini gain can be retained while improving decile monotonicity and robustness.
starting_knowledge: d03 direct ordinal XGBoost reached gini_weighted 0.376078, rank_gini 0.371076, pricing loss 638.261, and calibration 1.01208.
The d03 gain over LightGBM was promising but CV/bootstrap evidence was inconclusive and decile monotonicity weakened.
constraints: Run exactly one experiment and finish the delegation.
Use a champion-referenced XGBoost recipe override rather than changing model family or target framing.
Move clearly toward shallower trees and stronger regularization; avoid a near-duplicate parameter tweak.
Keep runtime within budget despite the lower learning rate.
success_criteria: Retain or improve weighted and rank Gini while strengthening stability/decile behavior and preserving calibration; otherwise establish that the original XGBoost capacity is preferable.
